full_query: So the singulair is an oral tablet not an inhaler?
sentences: Yes, Singulair (montelukast) is an oral tablet, not an inhaler
It is a leukotriene receptor antagonist used for the maintenance treatment of asthma and to relieve symptoms of seasonal allergies
Montelukast is available in various formulations, including tablets, chewable tablets, and an oral granule for suspension, but not an inhaler
